name: skillsafe
description: Back up your agent skills privately with version history and restore them on any machine, and deploy them as hosted web apps for yourself or to share.

interface.longDescription:
SkillSafe keeps your agent skills safe and puts them to work.

Back up and manage your skills: save the skills you've written to your private SkillSafe account. Every backup is a new version, nothing is shared, and you can list your backups and restore any version on this or another computer. Moving to a new machine takes one sign-in and one restore.

Deploy apps: turn your skills into a hosted web app at your-app.skillsafe.ai that runs in any browser, including on your phone. Keep it private for yourself, invite specific people by email, share a link, or list it in the public directory. Every upload is security-scanned.

The plugin has three skills: skillsafe-sign-in (connect your account through a browser sign-in, or deploy first on a temporary account and verify your email within 7 days to keep it), back-up-skills, and deploy-app. All requests go to api.skillsafe.ai with your own API key, stored only in ~/.skillsafe/config.json.
defaultPrompt: Back up my skills to SkillSafe.
Restore my SkillSafe skills on this computer.
Turn my skill into a private web app I can use from my phone.
